I'm a mathematician working at the intersection of **statistical mechanics**,
**information theory**, and **quantitative finance**. After several years doing
data science in the nonprofit sector, I'm now looking toward roles in quantitative
investing and AI.

This site is mostly a **blog** — a place to work through ideas ranging from
modern portfolio theory and log-optimal (Kelly) investing to Bayesian inference,
computational physics, and the occasional excursion into whatever I find beautiful.
Exposition ranges from late-undergraduate to research-seminar level.

Have a look at the [blog](blog.qmd), read more [about me](about.qmd), or say hello
on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jordan-mckittrick-3b1bb638/).
